# botpassport

> botpassport merges the IP address lists that OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Mistral AI, DuckDuckGo and Common Crawl publish for their crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, bingbot, Applebot, Amazonbot, CCBot and others) into one list refreshed daily, with exports for CrowdSec allowlists, nginx, Caddy and nftables, so a firewall never bans the crawlers of AI answer engines and search engines. MIT licence, Node.js 22, no runtime dependency.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ilanoh/botpassport/blob/main/README.md): install, CrowdSec sync, nginx, Caddy and nftables exports, sources, FAQ
- [Sources registry](https://github.com/ilanoh/botpassport/blob/main/src/sources.js): every crawler with its operator documentation and list URL
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ilanoh/botpassport/blob/main/AGENTS.md): layout, build, test and rules for contributors and coding agents
